name: promptfoo
description_en: Test your prompts, agents, and RAGs. Red teaming/pentesting/vulnerability scanning for AI. Compare performance of GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more. Simple declarative configs with command line and CI/CD integration.  Used by OpenAI and Anthropic.
readme_excerpt: Promptfoo: LLM evals & red teaming promptfoo is a CLI and library for evaluating and red-teaming LLM-based apps. Stop using trial-and-error... start shipping secure, reliable agents Website · Getting Started · Red Teaming · Documentation · Discord > Promptfoo is now part of OpenAI. Promptfoo remains open source and MIT licensed. Read the company update. Quick Start Also available via brew install promptfoo and pip install promptfoo. Or use npx promptfoo@latest to run any command without install…
